nodes.name: README
nodes.summary: Default Alembic-generated README noting the project uses a generic single-database migration configuration.

nodes.name: script.py.mako
nodes.summary: Alembic revision template used to scaffold new migration files with upgrade()/downgrade() stubs and revision metadata.
nodes.languageNotes: Mako template interpolates Alembic's revision variables (${up_revision}, ${imports}, etc.) into each newly generated migration module.

nodes.name: 0001_initial_schema.py
nodes.summary: Initial Alembic migration creating the full Unifolio schema — users, sessions, household_members, folios, schemes, arn_directory, and dialect-branched partitioned transactions/nav_history tables.
nodes.languageNotes: Branches on op.get_bind().dialect.name to create Postgres RANGE-partitioned transactions/nav_history tables versus plain SQLite equivalents, since SQLite has no native partitioning support.

nodes.name: 0002_transaction_dedupe_includes_type.py
nodes.summary: Migration widening the transactions table's dedupe unique constraint to include the transaction type column, fixing a bug where a same-day purchase and redemption of equal amount/units could collide and silently drop a transaction.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Alembic's batch_alter_table for SQLite (which lacks native ALTER TABLE DROP/ADD CONSTRAINT) while the Postgres path looks up and drops the constraint by name via information_schema.

nodes.name: upgrade
nodes.summary: Creates the full initial schema: users, sessions, household_members, folios, schemes, and arn_directory, plus dialect-branched partitioned transactions and nav_history tables.

nodes.name: downgrade
nodes.summary: Drops all tables created by the initial migration, executing raw DROP TABLE statements for the Postgres partitioned tables before dropping the remaining plain tables.

nodes.name: _create_transactions_plain
nodes.summary: Creates the non-partitioned SQLite variant of the transactions table with the same columns and unique constraint as the Postgres version.

nodes.name: _create_transactions_postgres
nodes.summary: Creates the Postgres RANGE-partitioned transactions table by date, then generates one child partition per calendar month via raw op.execute calls.

nodes.name: _create_nav_history_postgres
nodes.summary: Creates the Postgres RANGE-partitioned nav_history table by date and generates its monthly child partitions via raw SQL.

nodes.name: _upgrade_sqlite
nodes.summary: SQLite-specific upgrade path that inspects the existing unique constraint on transactions, drops it, and recreates it including the transaction type column via batch_alter_table (SQLite lacks native ALTER CONSTRAINT support).

nodes.name: SchemeMatch
nodes.summary: Small result value object carrying an AMFI code, scheme name, match confidence score, and category for a resolved CAS scheme name.

nodes.name: MfApiClient
nodes.summary: HTTP client wrapping the mfapi.in API — fetches and disk-caches the full scheme master list, fuzzy-matches a CAS scheme name against it via difflib.SequenceMatcher, resolves a scheme to an AMFI code with a confidence score, and looks up per-scheme category with the same TTL cache.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses difflib.SequenceMatcher for approximate string matching rather than a fuzzy-matching dependency, and a simple mtime-based TTL check for on-disk JSON caching.
